电磁场与电磁波试卷完整解答#

1、求矢量场的散度和旋度#

(1) A⃗=(3x2y+y2)e⃗x+(xy2−xz3)e⃗y+2xye⃗z\vec{A}=(3x^2 y+y^2)\vec{e}_x+(xy^2-xz^3)\vec{e}_y+2xy\vec{e}_zA=(3x2y+y2)ex​+(xy2−xz3)ey​+2xyez​#

散度 ∇⋅A⃗\nabla\cdot\vec{A}∇⋅A#

∇⋅A⃗=∂Ax∂x+∂Ay∂y+∂Az∂z=∂(3x2y+y2)∂x+∂(xy2−xz3)∂y+∂(2xy)∂z=6xy+2xy+0=8xy\begin{align*} \nabla\cdot\vec{A}&=\frac{\partial A_x}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial A_y}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial A_z}{\partial z}\\ &=\frac{\partial(3x^2y+y^2)}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial(xy^2-xz^3)}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial(2xy)}{\partial z}\\ &=6xy+2xy+0=\boldsymbol{8xy} \end{align*}∇⋅A​=∂x∂Ax​​+∂y∂Ay​​+∂z∂Az​​=∂x∂(3x2y+y2)​+∂y∂(xy2−xz3)​+∂z∂(2xy)​=6xy+2xy+0=8xy​

旋度 ∇×A⃗\nabla\times\vec{A}∇×A#

∇×A⃗=∣e⃗xe⃗ye⃗z∂∂x∂∂y∂∂z3x2y+y2xy2−xz32xy∣\nabla\times\vec{A}= \begin{vmatrix} \vec{e}_x & \vec{e}_y & \vec{e}_z \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \\ 3x^2y+y^2 & xy^2-xz^3 & 2xy \end{vmatrix}∇×A=​ex​∂x∂​3x2y+y2​ey​∂y∂​xy2−xz3​ez​∂z∂​2xy​​e⃗x:∂(2xy)∂y−∂(xy2−xz3)∂z=2x+3xz2e⃗y:−[∂(2xy)∂x−∂(3x2y+y2)∂z]=−(2y−0)=−2ye⃗z:∂(xy2−xz3)∂x−∂(3x2y+y2)∂y=(y2−z3)−(3x2+2y)=y2−z3−3x2−2y\begin{align*} \vec{e}_x&:\frac{\partial(2xy)}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial(xy^2-xz^3)}{\partial z}=2x+3xz^2\\ \vec{e}_y&:-\left[\frac{\partial(2xy)}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial(3x^2y+y^2)}{\partial z}\right]=-(2y-0)=-2y\\ \vec{e}_z&:\frac{\partial(xy^2-xz^3)}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial(3x^2y+y^2)}{\partial y}=(y^2-z^3)-(3x^2+2y)=y^2-z^3-3x^2-2y \end{align*}ex​ey​ez​​:∂y∂(2xy)​−∂z∂(xy2−xz3)​=2x+3xz2:−[∂x∂(2xy)​−∂z∂(3x2y+y2)​]=−(2y−0)=−2y:∂x∂(xy2−xz3)​−∂y∂(3x2y+y2)​=(y2−z3)−(3x2+2y)=y2−z3−3x2−2y​∇×A⃗=(2x+3xz2)e⃗x−2ye⃗y+(y2−z3−3x2−2y)e⃗z\nabla\times\vec{A}=\boldsymbol{(2x+3xz^2)\vec{e}_x-2y\vec{e}_y+(y^2-z^3-3x^2-2y)\vec{e}_z}∇×A=(2x+3xz2)ex​−2yey​+(y2−z3−3x2−2y)ez​

(2) A⃗=yze⃗x+xze⃗y+xy2e⃗z\vec{A}=yz\vec{e}_x+xz\vec{e}_y+xy^2\vec{e}_zA=yzex​+xzey​+xy2ez​#

散度 ∇⋅A⃗\nabla\cdot\vec{A}∇⋅A#

∇⋅A⃗=∂(yz)∂x+∂(xz)∂y+∂(xy2)∂z=0+0+0=0\nabla\cdot\vec{A}=\frac{\partial(yz)}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial(xz)}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial(xy^2)}{\partial z}=0+0+0=\boldsymbol{0}∇⋅A=∂x∂(yz)​+∂y∂(xz)​+∂z∂(xy2)​=0+0+0=0

旋度 ∇×A⃗\nabla\times\vec{A}∇×A#

∇×A⃗=∣e⃗xe⃗ye⃗z∂∂x∂∂y∂∂zyzxzxy2∣\nabla\times\vec{A}= \begin{vmatrix} \vec{e}_x & \vec{e}_y & \vec{e}_z \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \\ yz & xz & xy^2 \end{vmatrix}∇×A=​ex​∂x∂​yz​ey​∂y∂​xz​ez​∂z∂​xy2​​e⃗x:∂(xy2)∂y−∂(xz)∂z=2xy−xe⃗y:−[∂(xy2)∂x−∂(yz)∂z]=−(y2−y)=y−y2e⃗z:∂(xz)∂x−∂(yz)∂y=z−z=0\begin{align*} \vec{e}_x&:\frac{\partial(xy^2)}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial(xz)}{\partial z}=2xy-x\\ \vec{e}_y&:-\left[\frac{\partial(xy^2)}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial(yz)}{\partial z}\right]=-(y^2-y)=y-y^2\\ \vec{e}_z&:\frac{\partial(xz)}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial(yz)}{\partial y}=z-z=0 \end{align*}ex​ey​ez​​:∂y∂(xy2)​−∂z∂(xz)​=2xy−x:−[∂x∂(xy2)​−∂z∂(yz)​]=−(y2−y)=y−y2:∂x∂(xz)​−∂y∂(yz)​=z−z=0​∇×A⃗=(2xy−x)e⃗x+(y−y2)e⃗y\nabla\times\vec{A}=\boldsymbol{(2xy-x)\vec{e}_x+(y-y^2)\vec{e}_y}∇×A=(2xy−x)ex​+(y−y2)ey​

2、证明：(1) ∇×(∇ϕ)=0\nabla\times(\nabla\phi)=0∇×(∇ϕ)=0；(2) ∇⋅(∇×B⃗)=0\nabla\cdot(\nabla\times\vec{B})=0∇⋅(∇×B)=0#

(1) 标量梯度的旋度恒为0#

设 ∇ϕ=∂ϕ∂xe⃗x+∂ϕ∂ye⃗y+∂ϕ∂ze⃗z\nabla\phi=\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial x}\vec{e}_x+\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial y}\vec{e}_y+\frac{\partial\phi}{\partial z}\vec{e}_z∇ϕ=∂x∂ϕ​ex​+∂y∂ϕ​ey​+∂z∂ϕ​ez​

∇×(∇ϕ)=∣e⃗xe⃗ye⃗z∂∂x∂∂y∂∂z∂ϕ∂x∂ϕ∂y∂ϕ∂z∣\nabla\times(\nabla\phi)= \begin{vmatrix} \vec{e}_x & \vec{e}_y & \vec{e}_z \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \\ \frac{\partial\phi}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial\phi}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial\phi}{\partial z} \end{vmatrix}∇×(∇ϕ)=​ex​∂x∂​∂x∂ϕ​​ey​∂y∂​∂y∂ϕ​​ez​∂z∂​∂z∂ϕ​​​

e⃗x\vec{e}_xex​ 分量：∂2ϕ∂y∂z−∂2ϕ∂z∂y=0\displaystyle \frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial y\partial z}-\frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial z\partial y}=0∂y∂z∂2ϕ​−∂z∂y∂2ϕ​=0 e⃗y\vec{e}_yey​ 分量：−(∂2ϕ∂x∂z−∂2ϕ∂z∂x)=0\displaystyle -\left(\frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial x\partial z}-\frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial z\partial x}\right)=0−(∂x∂z∂2ϕ​−∂z∂x∂2ϕ​)=0 e⃗z\vec{e}_zez​ 分量：∂2ϕ∂x∂y−∂2ϕ∂y∂x=0\displaystyle \frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^2\phi}{\partial y\partial x}=0∂x∂y∂2ϕ​−∂y∂x∂2ϕ​=0 混合偏导顺序可交换，故 ∇×(∇ϕ)=0\boldsymbol{\nabla\times(\nabla\phi)=0}∇×(∇ϕ)=0。

(2) 矢量旋度的散度恒为0#

设 B⃗=Bxe⃗x+Bye⃗y+Bze⃗z\vec{B}=B_x\vec{e}_x+B_y\vec{e}_y+B_z\vec{e}_zB=Bx​ex​+By​ey​+Bz​ez​，先算旋度：

∇×B⃗=(∂Bz∂y−∂By∂z)e⃗x−(∂Bz∂x−∂Bx∂z)e⃗y+(∂By∂x−∂Bx∂y)e⃗z\nabla\times\vec{B}= \left(\frac{\partial B_z}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial z}\right)\vec{e}_x -\left(\frac{\partial B_z}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial B_x}{\partial z}\right)\vec{e}_y +\left(\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial B_x}{\partial y}\right)\vec{e}_z∇×B=(∂y∂Bz​​−∂z∂By​​)ex​−(∂x∂Bz​​−∂z∂Bx​​)ey​+(∂x∂By​​−∂y∂Bx​​)ez​

再求散度：

∇⋅(∇×B⃗)=∂∂x(∂Bz∂y−∂By∂z)−∂∂y(∂Bz∂x−∂Bx∂z)+∂∂z(∂By∂x−∂Bx∂y)=∂2Bz∂x∂y−∂2By∂x∂z−∂2Bz∂y∂x+∂2Bx∂y∂z+∂2By∂z∂x−∂2Bx∂z∂y=0\begin{align*} \nabla\cdot(\nabla\times\vec{B}) &=\frac{\partial}{\partial x}\left(\frac{\partial B_z}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial z}\right) -\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial B_z}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial B_x}{\partial z}\right) +\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\left(\frac{\partial B_y}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial B_x}{\partial y}\right)\\ &=\frac{\partial^2 B_z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^2 B_y}{\partial x\partial z} -\frac{\partial^2 B_z}{\partial y\partial x}+\frac{\partial^2 B_x}{\partial y\partial z} +\frac{\partial^2 B_y}{\partial z\partial x}-\frac{\partial^2 B_x}{\partial z\partial y}\\ &=0 \end{align*}∇⋅(∇×B)​=∂x∂​(∂y∂Bz​​−∂z∂By​​)−∂y∂​(∂x∂Bz​​−∂z∂Bx​​)+∂z∂​(∂x∂By​​−∂y∂Bx​​)=∂x∂y∂2Bz​​−∂x∂z∂2By​​−∂y∂x∂2Bz​​+∂y∂z∂2Bx​​+∂z∂x∂2By​​−∂z∂y∂2Bx​​=0​

混合偏导抵消，故 ∇⋅(∇×B⃗)=0\boldsymbol{\nabla\cdot(\nabla\times\vec{B})=0}∇⋅(∇×B)=0。

sin⁡π4=cos⁡π4=22\sin\frac{\pi}{4}=\cos\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{\sqrt2}{2}sin4π​=cos4π​=22​​E⃗=e⃗xE0⋅22cos⁡ωt,H⃗=e⃗yε0μ0E0⋅22cos⁡ωt\vec{E}=\vec{e}_x E_0\cdot\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\cos\omega t,\quad \vec{H}=\vec{e}_y\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}E_0\cdot\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\cos\omega tE=ex​E0​⋅22​​cosωt,H=ey​μ0​ε0​​​E0​⋅22​​cosωtS⃗=E⃗×H⃗=e⃗x×e⃗y⋅22E0cos⁡ωt⋅22E0ε0μ0cos⁡ωt\vec{S}=\vec{E}\times\vec{H}= \vec{e}_x\times\vec{e}_y \cdot \frac{\sqrt2}{2}E_0\cos\omega t \cdot \frac{\sqrt2}{2}E_0\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}\cos\omega tS=E×H=ex​×ey​⋅22​​E0​cosωt⋅22​​E0​μ0​ε0​​​cosωt=e⃗z⋅12E02ε0μ0cos⁡2(ωt)=\boldsymbol{\vec{e}_z \cdot \frac{1}{2}E_0^2\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}\cos^2(\omega t)}=ez​⋅21​E02​μ0​ε0​​​cos2(ωt)

(3) 时间平均坡印廷矢量 ⟨S⃗(z,t)⟩\langle\vec{S}(z,t)\rangle⟨S(z,t)⟩#

平均坡印廷：⟨S⃗⟩=12Re[E⃗˙×H⃗˙∗]\displaystyle \langle\vec{S}\rangle=\frac12\text{Re}\big[\dot{\vec{E}}\times\dot{\vec{H}}^*\big]⟨S⟩=21​Re[E˙×H˙∗]

E⃗˙=E0sin⁡k0z e⃗x,H⃗˙∗=ε0μ0E0cos⁡k0z e⃗y\dot{\vec{E}}=E_0\sin k_0 z\ \vec{e}_x,\quad \dot{\vec{H}}^*=\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}E_0\cos k_0 z\ \vec{e}_yE˙=E0​sink0​z ex​,H˙∗=μ0​ε0​​​E0​cosk0​z ey​E⃗˙×H⃗˙∗=E02ε0μ0sin⁡k0zcos⁡k0z e⃗z\dot{\vec{E}}\times\dot{\vec{H}}^*=E_0^2\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}\sin k_0 z \cos k_0 z\ \vec{e}_zE˙×H˙∗=E02​μ0​ε0​​​sink0​zcosk0​z ez​⟨S⃗⟩=12E02ε0μ0sin⁡k0zcos⁡k0z e⃗z=E024ε0μ0sin⁡(2k0z) e⃗z\langle\vec{S}\rangle=\frac12 E_0^2\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}\sin k_0 z \cos k_0 z\ \vec{e}_z =\boldsymbol{\frac{E_0^2}{4}\sqrt{\frac{\varepsilon_0}{\mu_0}}\sin(2k_0 z)\ \vec{e}_z}⟨S⟩=21​E02​μ0​ε0​​​sink0​zcosk0​z ez​=4E02​​μ0​ε0​​​sin(2k0​z) ez​

6、自由空间均匀平面波电场：E⃗˙=e⃗x10−4e−j20πz+e⃗yj10−4e−j20πz V/m\dot{\vec{E}}=\vec{e}_x 10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z}+\vec{e}_y j10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z}\ \text{V/m}E˙=ex​10−4e−j20πz+ey​j10−4e−j20πz V/m#

(1) 传播方向与频率#

相位因子 e−jβze^{-j\beta z}e−jβz，传播方向：+e⃗z\boldsymbol{+\vec{e}_z}+ez​ 自由空间 β=k0=ω/c=20π\beta=k_0=\omega/c=20\piβ=k0​=ω/c=20π

k0=2πfc=20π⇒f=20π⋅c2π=10ck_0=\frac{2\pi f}{c}=20\pi \Rightarrow f=\frac{20\pi\cdot c}{2\pi}=10ck0​=c2πf​=20π⇒f=2π20π⋅c​=10cf=10×3×108=3×109 Hz=3 GHz\boldsymbol{f=10\times3\times10^8=3\times10^9\ \text{Hz}=3\ \text{GHz}}f=10×3×108=3×109 Hz=3 GHz

(2) 极化方式#

E˙x=10−4e−j20πz, E˙y=j10−4e−j20πz=10−4ejπ/2e−j20πz\dot{E}_x=10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z},\ \dot{E}_y=j10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z}=10^{-4}e^{j\pi/2}e^{-j20\pi z}E˙x​=10−4e−j20πz, E˙y​=j10−4e−j20πz=10−4ejπ/2e−j20πz Ex,EyE_x,E_yEx​,Ey​ 幅度相等，yyy 分量相位超前 xxx 分量 π/2\pi/2π/2；沿+z+z+z传播，为左旋圆极化波。

(3) 磁场强度 H⃗˙\dot{\vec{H}}H˙#

均匀平面波关系：H⃗˙=1η0e⃗k×E⃗˙, η0=μ0ε0≈120π Ω, e⃗k=e⃗z\displaystyle \dot{\vec{H}}=\frac{1}{\eta_0}\vec{e}_k\times\dot{\vec{E}},\ \eta_0=\sqrt{\frac{\mu_0}{\varepsilon_0}}\approx120\pi\,\Omega,\ \vec{e}_k=\vec{e}_zH˙=η0​1​ek​×E˙, η0​=ε0​μ0​​​≈120πΩ, ek​=ez​

e⃗z×e⃗x=e⃗y,e⃗z×e⃗y=−e⃗x\vec{e}_z\times\vec{e}_x=\vec{e}_y,\quad \vec{e}_z\times\vec{e}_y=-\vec{e}_xez​×ex​=ey​,ez​×ey​=−ex​H⃗˙=1η0[e⃗z×(e⃗x10−4e−j20πz+je⃗y10−4e−j20πz)]\dot{\vec{H}}=\frac{1}{\eta_0}\big[\vec{e}_z\times(\vec{e}_x 10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z}+j\vec{e}_y 10^{-4}e^{-j20\pi z})\big]H˙=η0​1​[ez​×(ex​10−4e−j20πz+jey​10−4e−j20πz)]=10−4η0(e⃗y−je⃗x)e−j20πz=10−4120π(−je⃗x+e⃗y)e−j20πz A/m=\frac{10^{-4}}{\eta_0}\big(\vec{e}_y-j\vec{e}_x\big)e^{-j20\pi z} =\boldsymbol{\frac{10^{-4}}{120\pi}\left(-j\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y\right)e^{-j20\pi z}\ \text{A/m}}=η0​10−4​(ey​−jex​)e−j20πz=120π10−4​(−jex​+ey​)e−j20πz A/m

(4) 时间平均坡印廷矢量 ⟨S⃗⟩\langle\vec{S}\rangle⟨S⟩#

⟨S⃗⟩=12Re[E⃗˙×H⃗˙∗]\langle\vec{S}\rangle=\frac12\text{Re}\big[\dot{\vec{E}}\times\dot{\vec{H}}^*\big]⟨S⟩=21​Re[E˙×H˙∗]E⃗˙=10−4(e⃗x+je⃗y)e−j20πz,H⃗˙∗=10−4η0(−je⃗x+e⃗y)ej20πz\dot{\vec{E}}=10^{-4}(\vec{e}_x+j\vec{e}_y)e^{-j20\pi z},\quad \dot{\vec{H}}^*=\frac{10^{-4}}{\eta_0}(-j\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)e^{j20\pi z}E˙=10−4(ex​+jey​)e−j20πz,H˙∗=η0​10−4​(−jex​+ey​)ej20πzE⃗˙×H⃗˙∗=10−8η0[e⃗x×(−je⃗x)+e⃗x×e⃗y+je⃗y×(−je⃗x)+je⃗y×e⃗y]\dot{\vec{E}}\times\dot{\vec{H}}^*=\frac{10^{-8}}{\eta_0}\left[ \vec{e}_x\times(-j\vec{e}_x)+\vec{e}_x\times\vec{e}_y +j\vec{e}_y\times(-j\vec{e}_x)+j\vec{e}_y\times\vec{e}_y \right]E˙×H˙∗=η0​10−8​[ex​×(−jex​)+ex​×ey​+jey​×(−jex​)+jey​×ey​]

叉乘化简：e⃗x×e⃗y=e⃗z, e⃗y×e⃗x=−e⃗z\vec{e}_x\times\vec{e}_y=\vec{e}_z,\ \vec{e}_y\times\vec{e}_x=-\vec{e}_zex​×ey​=ez​, ey​×ex​=−ez​

=10−8η0[e⃗z+e⃗z]=2×10−8η0e⃗z=\frac{10^{-8}}{\eta_0}\big[\vec{e}_z + \vec{e}_z\big]=\frac{2\times10^{-8}}{\eta_0}\vec{e}_z=η0​10−8​[ez​+ez​]=η0​2×10−8​ez​⟨S⃗⟩=12⋅2×10−8120πe⃗z=10−8120πe⃗z W/m2\langle\vec{S}\rangle=\frac12\cdot\frac{2\times10^{-8}}{120\pi}\vec{e}_z =\boldsymbol{\frac{10^{-8}}{120\pi}\vec{e}_z\ \text{W/m}^2}⟨S⟩=21​⋅120π2×10−8​ez​=120π10−8​ez​ W/m2

7、自由空间均匀平面波磁场：H⃗(z,t)=(e⃗x+e⃗y)0.8cos⁡(6π×108t−2πz) A/m\vec{H}(z,t)=(\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)0.8\cos(6\pi\times10^8 t-2\pi z)\ \text{A/m}H(z,t)=(ex​+ey​)0.8cos(6π×108t−2πz) A/m#

(1) 频率、波长、相位常数、相速#

对比时谐形式 cos⁡(ωt−βz)\cos(\omega t-\beta z)cos(ωt−βz)：

ω=6π×108 rad/s,β=2π rad/m\omega=6\pi\times10^8\ \text{rad/s},\quad \beta=2\pi\ \text{rad/m}ω=6π×108 rad/s,β=2π rad/m
  • 频率：f=ω2π=6π×1082π=3×108 Hz=300 MHz\displaystyle f=\frac{\omega}{2\pi}=\frac{6\pi\times10^8}{2\pi}=\boldsymbol{3\times10^8\ \text{Hz}=300\ \text{MHz}}f=2πω​=2π6π×108​=3×108 Hz=300 MHz
  • 相位常数：β=2π rad/m\boldsymbol{\beta=2\pi\ \text{rad/m}}β=2π rad/m
  • 波长：λ=2πβ=1 m\displaystyle \lambda=\frac{2\pi}{\beta}=\boldsymbol{1\ \text{m}}λ=β2π​=1 m
  • 自由空间相速：vp=c=3×108 m/s\boldsymbol{v_p=c=3\times10^8\ \text{m/s}}vp​=c=3×108 m/s

(2) 电场强度 E⃗(z,t)\vec{E}(z,t)E(z,t)#

本征阻抗 η0=120π\eta_0=120\piη0​=120π，e⃗k=e⃗z\vec{e}_k=\vec{e}_zek​=ez​，H⃗˙=0.8(e⃗x+e⃗y)e−j2πz\dot{\vec{H}}=0.8(\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)e^{-j2\pi z}H˙=0.8(ex​+ey​)e−j2πz

E⃗˙=η0H⃗˙×e⃗k\dot{\vec{E}}=\eta_0 \dot{\vec{H}}\times\vec{e}_kE˙=η0​H˙×ek​E⃗˙=120π⋅0.8(e⃗x+e⃗y)e−j2πz×e⃗z=96π(−e⃗y+e⃗x)e−j2πz\dot{\vec{E}}=120\pi\cdot 0.8(\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)e^{-j2\pi z}\times\vec{e}_z =96\pi\left(-\vec{e}_y+\vec{e}_x\right)e^{-j2\pi z}E˙=120π⋅0.8(ex​+ey​)e−j2πz×ez​=96π(−ey​+ex​)e−j2πz

瞬时场：

E⃗(z,t)=96π(e⃗x−e⃗y)cos⁡(6π×108t−2πz) V/m\boldsymbol{\vec{E}(z,t)=96\pi(\vec{e}_x-\vec{e}_y)\cos(6\pi\times10^8 t-2\pi z)\ \text{V/m}}E(z,t)=96π(ex​−ey​)cos(6π×108t−2πz) V/m

(3) 瞬时坡印廷矢量 S⃗(z,t)=E⃗×H⃗\vec{S}(z,t)=\vec{E}\times\vec{H}S(z,t)=E×H#

E⃗=96π(e⃗x−e⃗y)cos⁡θ,θ=6π×108t−2πzH⃗=0.8(e⃗x+e⃗y)cos⁡θ\begin{align*} \vec{E}&=96\pi(\vec{e}_x-\vec{e}_y)\cos\theta,\quad \theta=6\pi\times10^8 t-2\pi z\\ \vec{H}&=0.8(\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)\cos\theta \end{align*}EH​=96π(ex​−ey​)cosθ,θ=6π×108t−2πz=0.8(ex​+ey​)cosθ​S⃗=96π⋅0.8⋅cos⁡2θ⋅(e⃗x−e⃗y)×(e⃗x+e⃗y)=76.8πcos⁡2θ⋅(e⃗x×e⃗y−e⃗y×e⃗x)=76.8πcos⁡2θ⋅(e⃗z+e⃗z)\begin{align*} \vec{S}&=96\pi\cdot0.8\cdot\cos^2\theta \cdot (\vec{e}_x-\vec{e}_y)\times(\vec{e}_x+\vec{e}_y)\\ &=76.8\pi \cos^2\theta \cdot (\vec{e}_x\times\vec{e}_y-\vec{e}_y\times\vec{e}_x)\\ &=76.8\pi \cos^2\theta \cdot (\vec{e}_z+\vec{e}_z) \end{align*}S​=96π⋅0.8⋅cos2θ⋅(ex​−ey​)×(ex​+ey​)=76.8πcos2θ⋅(ex​×ey​−ey​×ex​)=76.8πcos2θ⋅(ez​+ez​)​S⃗(z,t)=153.6πcos⁡2(6π×108t−2πz) e⃗z W/m2\boldsymbol{\vec{S}(z,t)=153.6\pi \cos^2(6\pi\times10^8 t-2\pi z)\ \vec{e}_z\ \text{W/m}^2}S(z,t)=153.6πcos2(6π×108t−2πz) ez​ W/m2

(4) 时间平均坡印廷矢量 ⟨S⃗⟩\langle\vec{S}\rangle⟨S⟩#

⟨cos⁡2θ⟩=12\langle\cos^2\theta\rangle=\displaystyle \frac12⟨cos2θ⟩=21​，故：

⟨S⃗⟩=153.6π⋅12e⃗z=76.8π e⃗z W/m2\langle\vec{S}\rangle=153.6\pi\cdot\frac12 \vec{e}_z =\boldsymbol{76.8\pi\ \vec{e}_z\ \text{W/m}^2}⟨S⟩=153.6π⋅21​ez​=76.8π ez​ W/m2

补充说明#

  1. 所有矢量推导严格使用直角坐标系叉乘、散度旋度公式；
  2. 传输线部分区分无耗特性，使用 λ/4\lambda/4λ/4 阻抗变换、驻波比、反射系数标准公式；
  3. 平面波区分线极化、圆极化判据，平均坡印廷统一采用复矢量公式 ⟨S⃗⟩=12Re[E⃗˙×H⃗˙∗]\displaystyle \langle\vec{S}\rangle=\frac12\text{Re}[\dot{\vec{E}}\times\dot{\vec{H}}^*]⟨S⟩=21​Re[E˙×H˙∗]；
  4. 自由空间本征阻抗取 η0=120π Ω\eta_0=120\pi\,\Omegaη0​=120πΩ，光速 c=3×108 m/sc=3\times10^8\,\text{m/s}c=3×108m/s。
